name: Check all hardening service status
description: Show status of all custom security/hardening systemd units (MAC randomise, VPN, usbguard, vault, DNS, kill switches, firewall, tmp clear)

examples.note: lists loaded/active units matching the hardening globs

portability: Loki-specific: globs match this machine's custom hardening unit names

name: Re-enable webcam + mic temporarily
description: Temporarily re-enable the camera and microphone via the custom hardening toggle script

examples.note: re-enables cam/mic until the disable service re-runs (e.g. reboot)

portability: Loki-specific: custom script at /usr/local/bin on the hardened box

name: Re-enable Bluetooth temporarily
description: Temporarily re-enable Bluetooth via the custom hardening toggle script

examples.note: re-enables Bluetooth until the disable service re-runs (e.g. reboot)

portability: Loki-specific: custom script at /usr/local/bin on the hardened box
